scripts.dev: npm run db:up && npm run db:setup && npm run dev:app
scripts.dev:app: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm start --prefix backend"
scripts.dev:angular: npm run db:up && npm run db:setup && npm run dev:angular:app
scripts.dev:angular:app: concurrently "npm run start --prefix frontend-angular" "npm start --prefix backend"
scripts.firebase-build: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.firebase-deploy: npm run firebase-build && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting
